newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia cuts repo rates to 20/25 pct from 30/40 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russia cuts repo rates to 20/25 pct from 30/40 pct.

text.p: The central bank said on Friday it was cutting the rate on its two-day repo facility to 20 percent for deals concluded on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday and 25 percent for deals on Thursday and Friday from 30 and 40 percent respectively.
The change in the repo rate takes effect from Friday, it said in a statement.
The repo facility is restricted to eligible primary dealers in the government securities market. At present 24 of the 42 primary dealers are eligible.
